coverage.justification: The line only forwards the flag to ci-git-publication.verify_publication. That function's live acceptance of an actual-github receipt with require_live_origin is tested in scripts/ci/ci-git-publication.test.py::test_actual_github_origin_needs_live_allocation_hosts_and_server_derived_identities; its hermetic refusal through this exact line is tested by ci-pr-proof.test.sh::test_prepare_rejects_a_hermetic_publication_origin_when_live_acceptance_is_required, which proves the flag arrives as True; and the live-policy PR universe runs --prepare on an actual-github receipt (LivePolicyPRTests).
coverage.residual_risk: No offline test runs ci-pr-proof.sh --prepare with the flag AND an actual-github receipt together, so a defect that appears only in that combination inside prepare() would first surface in the 253-114 hosted window.
